caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a horse figure positioned in a horizontal, leaping posture with all four legs extended outward. The horse is brown in color with visible shading to indicate the contours and musculature of its body. Its mouth is slightly open, eyes are wide and a small portion of the inside of the mouth is visible. The mane is short and lies close to the neck, while the tail is short and appears tufted. The horse has a rectangular, light-colored patch resembling a saddle or saddle blanket with a faded, mottled greenish-grey appearance, placed on its back. The hooves are a darker grayish color compared to the rest of the body. The background is a plain, beige color with light brownish spots and speckles scattered throughout the surface. There are no additional objects or elements in the composition.
